violations.explanation: The LongPressDraggable widget's child (the task item) lacks explicit semantic information indicating that it is a draggable item. Screen reader users will not be informed that they can long-press and drag these items.
The DragTarget widget (the 'Done' column) lacks explicit semantic information indicating that it is a drop target. Screen reader users will not be informed that they can drop items into this area.

The primary mechanism for moving tasks between 'To do' and 'Done' relies on a long-press and drag-and-drop gesture. While an IconButton exists to move tasks from 'To do' to 'Done', there is no explicit accessible alternative for initiating a drag action or for dropping an item into the 'Done' column for users who cannot perform complex gestures (e.g., keyboard-only users, users with motor impairments, or screen reader users who might struggle with drag-and-drop). The IconButton only covers one specific action (move to done) and doesn't make the drag-and-drop mechanism itself accessible.
